lines.en: I call Molly early in the morning, expecting her to not pick up so I can say “at least I tried” and then give myself an excuse to sulk for the rest of the day.
lines.zh: 我一大早就给 Molly 打电话，本以为她不会接，这样我就能说一句「至少我试过了」，然后给自己找个在接下来的时间里继续生闷气的借口。

lines.en: Unfortunately, she {i}does{/i} answer. And now I'm here on a park bench beside her, once again not understanding anything and wishing I called someone else instead.
lines.zh: 不幸的是，她{i}接了{/i}。于是我现在就坐在她旁边的公园长椅上，依旧什么都不明白，心里暗想要是打给别人就好了。

lines.en: Which isn't to say I dislike her. That's not true at all. I've gotten weirdly close to Molly over my time here. But I also know it won't ever go anywhere.
lines.zh: 倒不是说我不喜欢她。完全不是那么回事。在这里待的这段时间里，我和 Molly 莫名其妙地亲近了起来。但我也知道，这条路永远走不到头。

lines.en: She and I aren't “compatible.” Just look at us. The best we can do for one another is soak up each other's fleeting lust so it doesn't ooze out of our bodies and drown the city.
lines.zh: 她和我不「合适」。光是看看我们就明白了。我们能为彼此做的最好的事，就是吸干对方转瞬即逝的欲望，免得它从我们身体里渗出来，把整座城市淹了。

lines.en: But you know- maybe drowning the city would be good.
lines.zh: 不过话说回来——也许把这座城市淹了也不是什么坏事。

lines.en: It often feels like I'm underwater anyway. Like I'm trying to move, but my body's so weighed down that it won't cooperate.
lines.zh: 反正我本来就常常觉得自己像沉在水底。像是我想要动一动，可身体太沉了，怎么都不听使唤。

lines.en: I wonder how often everyone feels that way. And I wonder if any of those feelings would change if we had gills.
lines.zh: 我好奇其他人有多频繁地产生这种感觉。也好奇如果我们长着鳃，这些感觉会不会变得不一样。

lines.en: I think about fish being all fish-like. I stop thinking about Molly.
lines.zh: 我想着鱼有多么像鱼。我不再去想 Molly。

lines.en: But she doesn't stop thinking about me.
I can tell because I can still hear her from a hundred feet below sea level.
lines.zh: 我知道，因为哪怕在海平面下一百英尺，我依然能听见她的声音。
